fieldData.synopsis: The team finally cooks the most amazing meal for Phileas Fogg in Chef Soufflé's kitchen, with flavours from all around the world.

fieldData.name: Chef Soufflé

fieldData.name: India

fieldData.synopsis: The team is loving their journey around the world and heads to India to get spices.
fieldData.name: Up, Up and Away!

fieldData.synopsis: The team heads to Switzerland for chocolate, finding themselves at a chocolate factory meeting Klaus.
fieldData.name: Chocolate - YUM!

fieldData.synopsis: The team finds the keys to the Buzz Mobile and heads off to Mexico.
fieldData.name: Mexico!

fieldData.synopsis: The team rushes back to the Buzz Mobile and figures out the next country to visit is Mexico, but the keys are missing.
fieldData.name: Beans!

fieldData.name: Sushi!

fieldData.name: Sumo!

fieldData.name: Kangeroos, Koalas and Crocodiles

fieldData.name: Oz!

fieldData.name: Carnival Time!

fieldData.name: To Brazil!

fieldData.name: The Buzz Mobile

fieldData.name: Patty the Pastry Chef

fieldData.name: Everyone needs a friend

fieldData.name: Search for the Pearl

fieldData.name: The Test

fieldData.name: The Sea School

fieldData.name: The Pearl of the Ocean

fieldData.name: Wilhelmina the Whale Queen

fieldData.name: The Cave

fieldData.name: Shelley the Shark

fieldData.synopsis: Thandi, Ben and Ravi visit the Aquarium after school and find themselves in a weird and wonderful new place.

fieldData.name: Sniff, Sneeze and Shivers

fieldData.name: The Test

fieldData.name: Bounce!

fieldData.name: The Moon!

fieldData.synopsis: The hippos point the team to Ella the Elephant, who is amazing and knows a lot about elephants.
fieldData.name: Ella the Elephant

fieldData.name: Bush Clever
